title: Education
shortDescription: Creating opportunities for children, young people and adults to access quality education.
description: SAVE SALONE works with communities, schools, educators and partners to improve access to quality and inclusive education across Sierra Leone.

title: Environment
shortDescription: Protecting Sierra Leone's natural environment through community-led climate action.
description: Our environmental programmes promote sustainable communities, climate awareness, responsible waste management and protection of natural resources.

title: Agriculture
shortDescription: Supporting sustainable agriculture, food security and economic opportunities.
description: SAVE SALONE supports farmers and communities with knowledge, skills and opportunities that contribute to sustainable agriculture and improved food security.

title: Health
shortDescription: Improving access to health information, prevention and community wellbeing.
description: Our health initiatives focus on community awareness, preventive healthcare, maternal and child health, sanitation, hygiene and access to essential health information.

title: Human Rights & Legal Education
shortDescription: Promoting dignity, equality, justice and awareness of fundamental rights.
description: SAVE SALONE promotes human rights awareness and legal education so that individuals and communities understand their rights and can make informed decisions.
